# Data

```{r}
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS")
```

# Code for figure

```{r}
last_line_res_numeric <- df %>% select("MERO_dich_num","IMI_dich_num","MVB_dich_num","IR_dich_num","CZA_dich_num","TGC_dich_num","CST_dich_num","AMK_dich_num","PLZ_dich_num")  

# Get content
total_occurrences <- colSums(last_line_res_numeric) 
data_matrix <- as.matrix(last_line_res_numeric)
co_occurrence <- t(data_matrix) %*% data_matrix %>% as.matrix
co_occurrence_percent <- co_occurrence / total_occurrences * 100 

# Get clustering
drug_dist <- as.dist(
    1 - cor(t(co_occurrence_percent), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
)

drug_hc <- hclust(drug_dist, method = "average")
order <- drug_hc$order
final_variable_order <- colnames(co_occurrence_percent)[order]

# Reorder these
co_occurrence <- co_occurrence[order,order]
co_occurrence_percent <- co_occurrence_percent[order,order]

# Finish
co_occurrence_merged <- list()
for(i in 1:ncol(co_occurrence)){
    co_occurrence_merged[[i]] <- paste0(co_occurrence[,i],"\n(",round(co_occurrence_percent[,i],1),"%)")   # n over (%)
}

co_occurrence_merged <- do.call(cbind,co_occurrence_merged) %>% as.data.frame %>% `colnames<-`(gsub("_dich_num","",colnames(co_occurrence))
) 
diag(co_occurrence_merged) <- ""                                                 # blank diagonal (always 100%)

rownames(co_occurrence_merged) <- sapply(rownames(co_occurrence),FUN=function(x){
    total_count <- subset(total_occurrences,names(total_occurrences)==x)
    paste0(recode_resistance_variables(x)," resistant (n = ",total_count,")")
}) 

# Names
rownames(co_occurrence_percent) <- recode_resistance_variables(rownames(co_occurrence_percent)) 
colnames(co_occurrence_percent) <- recode_resistance_variables(colnames(co_occurrence_percent))
colnames(co_occurrence_merged) <- recode_resistance_variables(colnames(co_occurrence_merged))
diag(co_occurrence_percent) <- NA                                                # gray diagonal cells

## Cell size (pt)
cell_w <- 33                                                                     # cell width
cell_h <- 24                                                                     # cell height: two 7 pt lines

## Heatmap
co_occurrence_heatmap <- pheatmap(co_occurrence_percent %>% as.matrix,border_color = "black",name ="Cross-resistance", legend=F, fontsize = 7.75,
                                  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")))(100), breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
                                  na_col = "grey90",
                                  row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(co_occurrence_merged), gp = gpar(fontsize = 7.75)),
                                  column_names_max_height = max_text_width(colnames(co_occurrence_merged), gp = gpar(fontsize = 7.75)),   # space for 45° labels
                                  cluster_rows=F,cluster_cols = F, angle_col = "45",
                                  treeheight_col = 0, treeheight_row = 0,                                      # no reserved dendrogram space
                                  cellwidth = cell_w, cellheight = cell_h,
                                  display_numbers = as.matrix(co_occurrence_merged),
                                  labels_row = rownames(co_occurrence_merged), 
                                  number_color = "black",
                                  fontsize_number = 7.75)

## Complex heatmap legend (vertical, right of the row labels)
one_hundred_breaks <- seq(0, 100, length.out = 100)

fig_legend <- Legend(at = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%"),title = "Cross-resistance",direction = "vertical",col_fun = colorRamp2(breaks = one_hundred_breaks,colors = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name =  "RdYlBu")))(100)), title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7.75),labels_gp=gpar(fontsize=6.75), legend_height = unit(3, "cm"))

## Canvas: generous size so nothing is clipped; trimmed to content after saving
s1_w <- 9
s1_h <- 6
pad  <- unit(c(2, 10, 2, 8), "mm")                                               # bottom, left, top, right

# Print heatmap
s_figure_1 <- cowplot::ggdraw(grid.grabExpr(draw(co_occurrence_heatmap,
                                                 heatmap_legend_list = list(fig_legend),
                                                 heatmap_legend_side = "right", padding = pad),
                                            width = s1_w, height = s1_h))
```

## Save

```{r}
out <- "./figures/s_figure_1.png"
ggsave(plot = s_figure_1, filename = out,
       width = s1_w, height = s1_h, units = "in", dpi = 900, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)

# Trim surrounding white space, then add an even ~0.05 in margin
img <- image_read(out)
img <- image_trim(img)
img <- image_border(img, "white", "45x45")                                      # 45 px = 0.05 in at 900 dpi
image_write(img, out, density = 900)

# Final size (in)
info <- image_info(img)
c(width = info$width / 900, height = info$height / 900)
```

# Figure  

```{r,message=F,error=F,warning=F,fig.width=info$width/900,fig.height=info$height/900}
grid::grid.raster(img)
```
